summary: Iter66 Team Hub batch verified end-to-end. Backend /api/team/payments/{id}/remind now iterates EACH owing member individually (verified with 2 no-phone + 1 fake-555-phone members: all 3 appear in no_phone/failed, sent=0 for our test members). team_access is required (401/403 without auth). Signup share link creation + public /data returns roster_names list (drives dropdown) + slots. Public HTML page uses #007CFF blue accent, dropdown 'Choose your name…' with roster names + 'Other (type name)…' option (Other reveals a text input on selection). In-app Roster screen has the new ⋯ actions menu (testID roster-actions) showing 5 items: household, import, share, download-xlsx, download-csv. Team filter chips render well-spaced (All teams / Senior Elite Coed 5 / Youth Level 2 visible in one horizontal row). 7/7 backend pytest cases pass. Cleanup done: TEST_pp Coach and all TEST_ trackers/sheets/roster removed; team_access confirmed True.

issues: Slots on the PUBLIC page are still sorted only by `order` (backend/routers/share.py line 100), not by fill status. If the intent from 'SIGN-UP SORT' also applies to the public shareable page, full slots would need to sink to the bottom there too. Observation: the review request phrasing groups SIGN-UP SORT with 'in a sheet with multiple slots'; the in-app screen already does this correctly (frontend/app/team/signup-sheet.tsx L74-80). Not a blocking issue if intended for in-app only.

action_items: (Optional) Consider sorting fully-filled slots to the bottom on the PUBLIC share page too (backend/routers/share.py public_data — currently only sorts by 'order'). If the requirement was in-app only, no change needed.
No other fixes required — bug fix and Phase 1 batch verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/team_payments.py remind_owing: correctly iterates the full roster, filters excluded, skips fully-paid, resolves athlete->parent_phone vs personnel->phone, and never short-circuits on the first person. Response shape {sent, no_phone, failed} is stable and used by the frontend Alert.

frontend/app/team/payment.tsx nudgeOwing: uses Alert.alert confirm then POSTs /remind and shows a result Alert with truncated names — good UX; on web Alert may not fire (documented in review request).
frontend/app/team/roster.tsx: menu items and downloadRoster (CSV/XLSX via exportAoa) look correct. No stacked buttons remain.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: 3 TEST_iter66_* roster members (2 no-phone, 1 fake 555 phone), 1 TEST_iter66_Tracker payment tracker, 1 TEST_iter66_Sheet + 1 TEST_UI_iter66 signup sheets, share link. Also cleaned up leftover 'TEST_pp Coach' member. applereview keeps team_access=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint /api/team/payments/{tracker_id}/remind now uses individual per-member Twilio SMS with a {sent, no_phone, failed} response. To test without sending real texts: create roster members with either no parent_phone or a 555 fake number. Twilio IS configured in .env — never use a real phone in a test tracker.

Frontend nudgeOwing (payment.tsx L150-173) calls the new endpoint with a confirm/result Alert. Verified: iterating each owing member individually — all 3 test members (not just the first) appear in the response arrays.
